synthetic_basis.synthetic_property: local support/network context produces sign-level effective-service and reproductive rescue in two independently frozen blocks while also worsening some matched declines
synthetic_basis.interpretation: context-dependent branch allocator with buffering capacity, not a universal protective mechanism

empirical_question: When pollinator composition or global functional opportunity changes, is reproductive resilience explained by compensatory realized partner support and rate-weighted effective service, or does resilience persist after effective service itself declines and therefore require a downstream plant-side filter?
primary_empirical_estimand: rate_weighted_effective_service = sum over visitor classes of visit_rate_per_effort x source-native per-visit effectiveness
required_measurements: visitor-specific visit rate or abundance on the same effort scale
visitor-specific direct effectiveness such as single-visit pollen deposition or another source-native service outcome
reproductive output with an explicit denominator
candidate plant-side assurance/dependency measurement when network buffering and plant buffering must be distinguished

supports_network_context_or_service_redu: pollinator composition or upstream functional opportunity differs
different visitor classes compensate through abundance and/or per-visit effectiveness
rate-weighted total effective service is maintained or sign-rescued in the buffered unit
the result does not require high autonomous assurance to remain positive
weakens_network_context_as_sufficient_bu: rate-weighted total effective service is clearly lower in the buffered unit
no compensating visitor-specific service channel closes the service deficit
supports_downstream_filter_after_network: effective service remains lower after full visitor-specific accounting
a measured assurance/resource/demographic filter covaries with that maintenance in the same units
unresolved: visitor composition differs but per-visit effectiveness is absent
contact or occurrence is available but cannot be converted to direct effective service
breeding-system index is available but autonomous dependency/assurance is not
different studies cannot be linked at the matched population/season hierarchy

system_specific_frozen_predictions.current_observation: Guanica and Mona have strongly different visitor assemblages and visitation levels but similar selfing/outcrossing ISI; autonomous fruiting is negligible on both islands.
system_specific_frozen_predictions.network_context_prediction: If network context/service redundancy explains reproductive resilience, visitor-specific rate x effectiveness should yield similar or otherwise compensated total effective service across the population contrast despite the composition difference.
system_specific_frozen_predictions.falsifying_or_weakening_pattern: Mona or Guanica has materially lower rate-weighted effective service while controlled reproductive performance remains similar and no compensating visitor channel is present.
system_specific_frozen_predictions.current_missing_link: visitor-specific single-visit effectiveness/direct pollen function and matched rate-weighted effective service
system_specific_frozen_predictions.assurance_prediction: Autonomous assurance alone should not explain the contrast because spontaneous autogamy is negligible.

system_specific_frozen_predictions.current_observation: signed bill-flower mismatch predicts pollen contact/robbing and high reproductive performance coexists with frequent robbing/resource change; two focal Clermontia species have historical exact-taxon assurance support but no same-context numeric dependency estimate.
system_specific_frozen_predictions.network_context_prediction: A network-context explanation requires contemporary partner-specific visitation x direct effectiveness to show compensated total effective service despite the altered interaction-quality mixture.
system_specific_frozen_predictions.falsifying_or_weakening_pattern: direct rate-weighted effective service remains reduced after partner-specific accounting while fruit/seed performance remains high.
system_specific_frozen_predictions.downstream_filter_prediction: If service remains reduced, same-context autonomous assurance or resource/demographic compensation must explain the remaining reproductive resilience.
system_specific_frozen_predictions.current_missing_link: same-context rate-weighted effective service plus controlled dependency/assurance

system_specific_frozen_predictions.current_observation: strong autonomous-assurance and floral differences exist but a current island service deficit was not detected in the existing cross-study bridge.
system_specific_frozen_predictions.network_context_prediction: If contemporary network context maintains service, same-season partner-specific rate-weighted service should remain adequate across the island/mainland comparison; this would explain current resilience but not by itself the origin of the established trait difference.
system_specific_frozen_predictions.falsifying_or_weakening_pattern: same-season direct service is equivalent and establishment history predicts the trait/assurance difference better than network structure.
system_specific_frozen_predictions.current_missing_link: same-season same-population direct service, assurance and reproductive linkage

system_specific_frozen_predictions.prediction: physical access failure should produce lower direct effective service for the inaccessible morph and the reproductive asymmetry should follow rather than be sign-rescued by local partner context

mapping_rule: No system can be mapped to the synthetic local-support parameter merely because its visitor assemblage differs. A source-native mapping must define the empirical support/redundancy variable before the reproductive target is tested.
parameter_rule: The frozen synthetic support strength must not be tuned to match an observed system. Empirical data can test the direction/signature of the mechanism or motivate a new separately frozen mapping, but cannot retroactively choose the support strength that makes a known outcome fit.
claim_boundary: These predictions distinguish network-context buffering from downstream plant buffering. They do not assert that Guaiacum, Hawaiʻi, Nicotiana, or Ogasawara is generated by the ABM local-support parameter.
